purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body1: These Terms of Service (ToS) govern access to and use of the Vuvio platform, available via the mobile app and website.
purpose.body2: By creating an account or using Vuvio, you unconditionally accept these ToS. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

account.title: Account creation
account.body: To access Vuvio features, you must create an account with a valid email address. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and any activity performed from your account.

age.title: Minimum age
age.body: Vuvio is reserved for users aged at least {{age}}. By creating an account, you certify that you meet the age requirement.

userContent.title: User-generated content
userContent.body: By broadcasting or publishing content on Vuvio, you grant the platform a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to display, distribute, and promote that content within the service. You retain ownership of your content.

imageRights.title: Right of publicity
imageRights.body: You agree not to film or broadcast individuals without their consent. Vuvio cannot be held liable for broadcasts made by its users. Reported content will be reviewed and may be removed.

safety.title: Safety and conduct
safety.body: You agree not to endanger your own safety or that of others during your broadcasts. Illegal, dangerous, or public-order-threatening activities are strictly prohibited.

forbidden.title: Prohibited content
forbidden.body: Strictly prohibited on Vuvio: hateful, discriminatory, pornographic, violent, or illegal-activity-inciting content, as well as any content infringing third-party rights (copyright, trademarks, privacy).

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.body: Vuvio reserves the right to moderate, suspend, or remove any content that violates these ToS, without notice or justification. A moderation team may intervene at any time.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Any user may report inappropriate content through the app. Vuvio is committed to reviewing reports promptly and taking appropriate action.

location.title: Location data
location.body: Vuvio may use your geographic location to display your lives on the world map and improve content discovery. This data is not sold to third parties. You can disable location tracking in the privacy settings.

availability.title: Service availability
availability.body: Vuvio strives to ensure continuous service but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability. Planned maintenance or technical incidents may cause temporary outages.

paid.title: Paid features
paid.body: Certain Vuvio features may be offered for a fee. Pricing conditions will be specified at the time of their introduction and will require explicit acceptance.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.body: Vuvio may display advertisements or sponsored content within the app. This revenue helps fund the platform and maintain free access to core features.

suspension.title: Suspension and termination
suspension.body: Vuvio reserves the right to suspend or delete any account in the event of a breach of these ToS, fraudulent behaviour, or endangerment of others — without notice in serious cases.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: Vuvio shall not be liable for direct or indirect damages resulting from use of the platform, user-published content, or service interruptions. The platform is provided as-is.

changes.title: Changes to these ToS
changes.body: Vuvio reserves the right to modify these ToS at any time. Users will be notified of material changes. Continued use of the platform after notification constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These ToS are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, the competent courts shall be those of Vuvio's registered office, unless otherwise required by law.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any questions regarding these ToS, you can reach us at:

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.intro: Vuvio is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, why, how long we retain it, and what your rights are.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body: We collect data you provide directly (name, email, profile photo, bio, equipment), data generated by your activity (live broadcasts, follows, messages, interactions), technical data (IP address, device type, browser, connection logs), and, with your consent, your geographic location.

waitlist.title: Launch waitlist
waitlist.body: If you join from the landing page, we collect your email address, selected language and consent date to send a confirmation email, then one email when Vuvio launches. This does not subscribe you to a general marketing newsletter. Resend delivers the confirmation email. Cloudflare Turnstile checks automated submissions; your IP address is not stored in the waitlist.
waitlist.retention: We keep your address until the launch announcement is sent, or for no more than 730 days after signup. We then delete it. The consent record is kept with your signup for the same period.
waitlist.withdraw: You can withdraw through the link shown after signup, the unsubscribe link in the future email, or by writing to

location.title: Location data
location.body: Your geographic location is used solely to display your lives on the world map and improve content relevance. It is not sold. You can disable location tracking at any time in the app's privacy settings.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.body: Vuvio does not sell your personal data. It may be shared with technical service providers (hosting, video infrastructure, analytics, email delivery) strictly within the scope of service delivery and under a data processing agreement. In the event of a legal obligation, certain data may be disclosed to competent authorities.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object to processing of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at

security.title: Security
security.body: Vuvio implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, or alteration: encrypted communications (HTTPS/TLS), strict access controls, Firestore security rules, and Firebase Authentication.

children.title: Children
children.body: Vuvio is not intended for minors. We do not knowingly collect personal data from persons under the age of 13. If we discover that an account belongs to a minor, we will delete it promptly.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: This policy may be updated. Any material change will be notified to you within the app. Continued use of Vuvio after notification constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

alert.p2: This form is for technical issues and non-urgent reports only.

help.title: Help Center
help.intro: Find answers to the most common questions about Vuvio.

whatIsVuvio.question: What is Vuvio?
whatIsVuvio.p1: Vuvio is a live streaming platform where creators share first-person POV experiences from anywhere in the world — concerts, markets, kitchens, mountains.
whatIsVuvio.p2: As a viewer, you travel the world in real time. As a creator, you share your daily life or passion with a global audience.

howDiscover.question: How do I discover lives?
howDiscover.intro: Several ways to explore what's live:
howDiscover.item1: Watch — the main feed with all current and recent lives
howDiscover.item2: Explore — browse by category or theme
howDiscover.item3: Globe — visualise lives on an interactive world map
howDiscover.item4: Search — find creators or specific content
howDiscover.item5: Notifications — get alerted when a creator you follow goes live
howDiscover.footer: Lives are displayed in real time — the feed updates automatically.

mapCategories.question: What categories are available on the map?
mapCategories.intro: Lives are organised into themed categories:
mapCategories.footer: More categories are added regularly as the community grows.

openLive.question: How do I open and watch a live?
openLive.p1: Tap any live card in the feed or on the map to open it.
openLive.item1: Watch the live stream in full screen
openLive.item2: See the creator's location on the mini-map
openLive.item4: View the equipment the creator is using
openLive.item5: Follow the creator to get notified of future lives

videoStops.question: The video keeps stopping — what should I do?
videoStops.intro: Buffering can be caused by several factors:
videoStops.item4: Background app activity on your device
videoStops.footer: Try refreshing the page or switching to a better network.

afterEnds.question: What happens when a live ends?
afterEnds.p1: When a creator ends their live, it stops automatically for all viewers.
afterEnds.p2: A recap is generated and made available on the creator's profile.

startLive.question: How do I start a live?
startLive.step1: Create a Vuvio account or log in
startLive.step2: Tap the + button in the bottom navigation bar
startLive.step5: Add a title and optional description

chooseLocation.question: How do I choose the right location?
chooseLocation.intro: Your location appears on the globe and helps viewers find you:
chooseLocation.item1: Use your actual GPS location for authenticity
chooseLocation.item2: Or set a manual location if you prefer privacy
chooseLocation.item3: Be as specific as a city or as broad as a region
chooseLocation.item4: Accurate location improves your discoverability on the map
chooseLocation.footer: Your precise address is never shared — only the approximate area.

permissions.question: The app is asking for camera or microphone access — is that normal?
permissions.p1: Yes. Camera and microphone access are required to broadcast a live stream.
permissions.p2: These permissions are only used while you are actively streaming. You can revoke them at any time from your device settings.

pause.question: Can I pause a live?
pause.p1: There is no pause feature — a stream is either live or ended.
pause.p2: If you need to stop temporarily, you can end the stream and start a new one. Viewers will be notified when you go live again.

editProfile.question: How do I edit my profile?
editProfile.p1: Go to your profile and tap Edit Profile.

changeEmail.question: How do I change my email address?
changeEmail.answer: Go to Settings → Account. You will be asked to confirm your current password before making changes. If you signed in with Google, your email is managed through your Google account.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: To request account deletion, contact us at hello@vuvio.app with your registered email address. We will process your request within 30 days in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

report.question: How do I report inappropriate content?
report.answer: While watching a live, tap the menu (⋯) and select Report. Describe the issue and submit. Our moderation team reviews all reports promptly.

block.question: Can I block a user?
block.answer: Blocking is being rolled out. In the meantime, you can report any user via the Report option in the live or profile menu.

danger.question: What if someone is in danger?
danger.answer: If you witness an emergency situation during a live, contact local emergency services (112 in Europe, 911 in North America) immediately. You can also report the stream to us at hello@vuvio.app.
